t: Chase away the shadows near the front entrance.

What? Was I drinking? Well... Maybe! How can I not when the lord is like this...? And I've seen some horrors lately. There are shadows at our front door... Dark as night... And angry...

It's terrifying! I needed some liquid courage...

Can you chase those shadows away? Maybe the lord will recover then!
Well, what is it? Are they still around? What horror...
Are there fewer of them now? Thank the Light... They kept wandering around, the pests... I'm going to stay here in case they come back. What if they eat me? It happens!
He's just lying around... Should I read the news to him? Or make dinner? There is nothing in the pantry. Just the pudding...
h: How do I get him up?

t: He's in a bad way today. Normally he would eat breakfast, scold me... But today he just lies there...

All sorts of nasty things have gathered in the city of Dar-Ulgorn, , among them various creatures of darkness, like shadows...

Because we didn't have enough problems already...

These shadows are now causing panic on Starkov Mountain, so the residents are complaining. Something needs to be done.

I'm passing the order: eliminate a dozen shadows, then report to Fergard.
Shadows are creatures of darkness, and darkness, as you understand, is in abundance here now... The Empress said to punish those who attack citizens, and we carry out her instructions.
Help Olga Ilyinsky clean the apartment.

It's a mess in here, Ilya! How can you live like this? Doesn't Zakhar clean up? Agatha can't do it alone!

Listen, , help me clean up this place... Otherwise, Ilya will just lie among all this garbage... Perhaps, if the rooms are clean, he will stop lying there like a sack of potatoes!

I'll put away the clothes, and you pick up these torn papers and throw them away.
Go now, I need to clean up this mess or it will be here forever.

Well, it seems like this place is cleaner now... Of course, Ilya should just move in with Agatha - she's his wife, after all - and not live in this rented apartment...

But he says, "Let others move in if they want to. I can't stand change!" So here we are... It's not like we can force him!
Find Mikhey Tarantiev or Ivan Muhoyarov and collect the debt.

The townspeople turn to us with all kinds of requests, . One of them is this. A certain Andre de Roche wrote us about his friend Ilya Oblomov. He says he was robbed by some swindlers, Mikhey and Ivan who fraudulently received part of the profits from his estate.

You can meet these two scoundrels on Starkov Mountain; they constantly change their location.

Andre wants us to get at least part of the debt from them. Well... I see no reason to refuse him, we don't like scammers and swindlers here! Deal with this. The methods are up to you. Then you will give everything to this elf, he provides certain services to us.
Thank you very much! This is only a small part, of course. We hope to recover the rest in time. Your help in bringing these scoundrels to reason is invaluable.
Search for the letter to Oblomovka in the trash.

The next task is the following, . We have been asked to find a lost item. The thing is, Ilya Oblomov wrote a letter to his village Oblomovka, compiling a list of proposals and instructions.

However, his careless servant Zakhar managed to lose the letter somewhere. He doesn't remember where exactly, but the letter most likely ended up in the trash. Oblomov cannot reconstruct it from memory.

Therefore, I ask you to start looking for the letter. Then take it to Fergard, he will make sure it's sent.

A letter? And it smells like garbage. What did you do with it?

Eh, okay, give it here. I'll send it as soon as possible. Don't bring me anything like this again, I beg you.

When are we supposed to live? When are we supposed to live, ? Up to my ears in work...

There is another problem - these vile ghouls won't let me sleep, howling all night long... Could you chase them away? I came up with a good plan: to gather the police from all over the city, surround them and pick them off one by one... I need to go to the mayor, but there is no time - there is still a lot to think about.

Maybe you can solve this problem?
I can still hear their screams! What torment...
Oh, thank you, you're helping out again... I hope they'll shut up for a while... I was just thinking of getting some sleep...

Our fight against the distorted creatures continues,  - we battle them tirelessly.

Today we will deal with another species - ghouls. They are scum, corpse-eating bone-eaters, and distorted ghouls is something one should never have to lay eyes on.

But they settled in one of the squares next to Starkov Mountain. So thin their ranks. A dozen will be enough. When you are done, report to Andre de Roche, he oversees the situation in the quarter.
Oh, are the ghouls truly gone? Or not yet? But it is important that the struggle continues, because movement is life! Thank you.
Work gives form, and completeness, and a purpose to life.
Get shadow food from the merchant Ofenya after fulfilling his task.

Poor Ilya! He can't do anything himself, and his assistants - let's face it, they're not great either... Zakhar started drinking as soon as he saw shadows, and Agatha needs to look after her brother and his friends, she can't manage it all alone...

But Ilya still needs to eat, even though he's a ghost. There are special groceries for ghosts... The merchant Ofenya sells it around the corner...

Perhaps you could run to him quickly, ?
You're still here? Ofenya sells goods nearby, you can get there within a couple of minutes...

Oh, I just saw something terrible! Oh, I nearly died!

Have you brought food for Ilyusha? Thank you very much! But what does food matter when there are horrors outside?! Oh!

Just listen to them! Down with our empress, down with the Great Mages, down with the Church and all authority in general! They want to rule everything themselves and organize a government of the people, imagine that! How would common people rule? Nothing of the kind has ever happened in Kania, Xadagan, or among the Elves!

Bring them to heel, ! Or else the purple uniforms will show up, and they'll beat up everyone. Them - for shouting, us - for listening!
Ugh, that vermin! The thing they say - my poor ears...
Thank you so much. Perhaps they will leave this quarter alone now, and I can sell my goods in peace... Well, you can buy what you've come here to buy now...
Foodstuffs! They are not quite fresh or appetizing, but they are fine for ghosts! Take your pick! Before they go to waste!

Ugh, I wish I could sell it to you, but look around you! These nihilists showed up, yelling and breaking everything. Scared away all my customers, you're the only one left. Please get rid of them! Deal?
h: How much for the food for ghosts?

t:
We have a new enemy, , one we haven't seen before. Rebels! Rioters! They oppose the authorities and incite others.

These are the dissatisfied people who are tired of waiting for resurrection. They call themselves nihilists because they no longer believe in anyone.

But this is a riot! And we must suppress riots. Deal with it before it breaks out all over the city!
Yes, there is a problem... Someone is inciting our dear citizens to revolt, but who? I'll try to learn more about this...
Neutralize 8 maniacs by using Provoker and disguising yourself.

There are killings again, ! We received reports that some perverts at Starkov Mountain attack young girls in the alleys.

Let's do this: I'll give you an artifact that will disguise you for a short time, so you can lure those maniacs out. Then you'll kill them, take their knives, and bring them to me as proof.
Well, there are fewer of them now - that's good, I hope these freaks will not be resurrected soon...
Find the Dark Maiden and defeat it, then discuss the situation with Alyosha.

Oh! Such horror... I'm still shaking...

I was going to visit Ilya - and then I saw her, standing in the middle of the street. Six arms, clawed hands, four eyes - staring at me like a spider at a fly...

I nearly died right there, but she didn't do anything - just gave me a look and vanished...

Why does this nightmare even exist?! Is the empress doing anything about this, ?
Is she still out there? Oh, I'm scared to leave my house!
Ugh, I told them to stay away from my subjects and behave! They got out of hand.
Find out what Ilya Oblomov can do for you as a companion.

I need to take a walk... Perhaps I should visit some of my old friends?

But... I feel like I owe you... How can I repay you? Unfortunately, money is rather tight these days; my village hasn't been turning a profit for a while, there's nothing but losses.

Unless... I can tell people about your exploits. But I will need to see you performing them...
As you can see, I can be useful too! Next time you are performing feats, use my calling card to summon me - I'll come and be an eyewitness!
Meet Negus Tot and offer a prayer to the Light.

, as you understand, I can't tell you everything here.

But it's simple: the gaze of our ruler is now focused on her new capital - Jigran.

The Church of Light opposed her power, gaining a foothold in the Cathedral, located in the center of the city. And it seems that Hirkalla can't do anything about it for now.

This is our chance... to help her. You will find out how from Negus Tot, director of the ZIT Headquarters, my old comrade-in-arms in the Kirah Expedition. You already know him. Negus Tot, despite his devotion to science, is a very... ahem... ardent expert in the affairs of the Church. You can find him on the second floor of Yasker's Tower, in the residence of the Zem people.
Light will illuminate the darkness and dispel doubts.
You had a vision? Interesting... Tell me everything.

I suppose we should join Hiero and his Paladins at the Cathedral on Jigran. Their faith is so strong that they were able to create a protective barrier around the temple.

At the research institute, we have created a device that will allow us to travel to Jigran undetected.

But first, let's pray, . And ask the Light for guidance...
Meet Marianne de Ardeur and offer a prayer to the Light.

As you understand, I can't tell you everything here, .

The thing is, the gaze of our ruler is now focused on her new capital - Jigran.

The Church of Light opposed her power, gaining a foothold in the Cathedral, located in the center of the city. And it seems that Hirkalla can't do anything about it for now.

This is our chance... to do something. Marianne de Ardeur of the Kanian Archipelago will tell you more. Marianne has been eager to start doing something for a while, but we had to wait until recently. You can find her in her usual spot.
Is there a force that can oppose Darkness other than Light?
Vision? Prophecy? It happens, don't be surprised... Tell me what you saw.
You are an aberration in the fabric of existence. A blot. A mistake! And I will fix this mistake!
Use the portable teleporter to travel to Jigran and meet with Hiero.

Interesting but unclear, .

Fate? A complex matter. I remember that the Gibberlings have some beliefs associated with it, but what is it exactly...?

I'm afraid there is no time to think about it now. I hope the Light will reveal everything to you over time. And now - onward to Jigran. I will follow you right away, we will meet in the Cathedral.

I've been waiting to meet you. It sounds like nothing in Sarnaut happens without your involvement, .

Welcome to Jigran!
Use the portable teleporter to travel to Jigran and meet with Hiero.

Interesting, but I'm afraid I'm a bad interpreter of prophecies, .

I know that the Gibberlings believe in fate, and perhaps you should ask the Gray Family or Froddy himself...

However, we have little time and therefore we will have to postpone solving this. Let's hope the Light sends you other visions And now - onward to Jigran. I will follow you right away, we will meet in the Cathedral.

I've been waiting to meet you. It sounds like nothing in Sarnaut happens without your involvement, .

Welcome to Jigran!
Get to the casino in Dartasovo and learn about the next "odd person out".

Katerina absorbed the energy of the thunderstorm, which made her very powerful. Who knows, maybe her old fate where she was a simple merchant was worse...

However, even though I sense another Dark Maiden lurking nearby, we are still far from our goal. There are three "odd people out" left. Well, the chances are slim.

We should talk to that gambler who doesn't want to try his luck, …We need to hurry, the Paladins' barrier is weakening. They have returned to the Cathedral, and there are more corrupted creatures in the city…
Hire a carriage and return to the city...
Curse this day! It's like everything is trying to fight me... If only I knew the secret to winning... I would be rich and there would be no obstacles before me!
Learn the secret of three cards from Boris Golitsyn by beating him.

Take a risk? Stake everything?

I'm not very rich, yes. I'm a simple military engineer from Tlavia... If I lose... I'll be finished! I'll never be able to pay it off...

But my friend Boris comes from an old and wealthy family. They say his grandmother, a countess, knows some mysterious secret that helped her win back her losses... I wish I knew it, .
Boris knows a lot, but he doesn't want to talk...

My grandma hasn't gambled since! And who would fall in love with her anyway... She lived before the Cataclysm, and now she's resurrected like everyone else. So I think she can continue to exist peacefully. And you? Are you ready to fulfill your promise? Will you pay off my debt?

This gambling house belongs to Goga Ace, the cunning goblin... I owe him. There he is, on his couch.
Complete four quests of the casino's owner.

, I see Boriska has got you to help me! Hehe. He's a sly dog. He has money, I know he does.

Okay, I won't make you do the dirty work: the toilets are cleaned, and my other debtors entertain the guests!

My tasks will be simple. If you complete them, you'll pay off Golitsyn's debt.
I see that everything is done! And the night is ending... Now I know I can rely on you in time of need... I have a lot of debtors - one of them will definitely pass the debt onto you again, hehe.

The thing is, some gamblers often lose - and sometimes they end up owing the casino, yeah.

Of course, we're willing to wait a little, but there's a limit to everything. Here's a list of those who owe me. They're all hanging around the area, so it should be easy to find them.

, collect their debts. If they refuse to pay, shake them down. You can do that, right?
Okay, let's count it, hehe. It looks like it's all here, mhm! Well done!

Besides the current debtors, there are also... potential ones, so to speak. Hehe. All sorts of wealthy people who have yet to visit our wonderful establishment and get addicted to gambling!

I have prepared some personal invitations, so I suggest you hand them out...These individuals are hanging around our establishment, so I believe they've wanted to come in for a while.

Here, , hand them out – let them come play!
What, everyone agreed? Wonderful! We need new players here!
Hand out 4 additional invitations near the Cathedral, Palace and Radovo Estate.

By the way, why invite only those near the casino? The city is full of dumb... err, I mean, future players who dream of trying their luck in our wonderful establishment!

We need to invite all the famous rich people here. In short, , you can fulfill my request or not - but here are the invitations, no longer personalized... Hand them out near the Cathedral, the Palace and Famusov's if you can... Tell everyone to come here!
My plan works! At this rate we'll need to expand... As for you, thank you very much!

Aho, frriend! Aho, friend! We on Howlem could not stand by when such great things were happening.

We have already seen the consequences of Hirkalla's actions when the Great Tree of Howlem began to wither and die, and our island began to collapse. We will not allow this to happen again, and if you need to free the All-Mother, we are ready.
I have been on the bench fifteen years, and when I take a look into a report, I despair. Nezeb in all his wisdom could not tell what is true and what is not true in it.
I want to be no worse than other noble ladies... If I'm strange, it's not my fault.
Ah, what's so bad about brotherly love? To each his own.
I was once the Emperor of Kania, but who am I now? And where is that Kania that I once ruled?
They consider me an idiot, but I'm clever, and they don't even realize.
Most importantly, I needed to get out of this terrible marriage. The lot of a robber's wife seemed like paradise compared to the fate that awaited me.
Chase away 10 strangers from the garden and park around the casino.

My guests are gems and glittering coins, hehe! At least that's how I see them...

But, alas, there are not just gems in the world, but also all sorts of boulders! My wonderful garden is filled with beggars! They are not going to play our games, they just loiter about, scaring away my customers!

Please drive these scoundrels away, ! They have no place here!
Oh, freebie hunters. They just don't want to pay! Kick them all out! We have an elite society of gambling enthusiasts here!
Chase away 10 strangers from the garden and park around the casino.

My wife has convinced me that the homeless around the casino pose a serious problem. These people are a threat to public safety, they are creating disorder and unrest among our residents. We cannot allow them to stay here and continue to cause trouble.

I know my conservative principles may be too strict in this case, but I ask you, , to help us drive out these homeless people and restore peace in our region.

My wife may be right about many things, so I'd rather not let her and our community down. Help us get rid of this menace.
Casino guests complained a lot about these homeless people...
Light or repair 6 lanterns in the garden.

Luckily for us, the corrupted haven't gotten into our casino yet! After all, it used to be a fortress... But they do attack the garden from time to time... They break the lanterns! They seem to hate light...

But we need light... We have other entertainment in the dark - which is not cards! We should fix the lanterns since they bother these creatures...

In short, light them again, . If something is broken, fix it. You need Spark energy for that... Do you have it?
I see the lights are working again! Hehe! Okay, that was an easy task...
Light or repair 6 lanterns in the garden near the casino.

Recently I noticed that the lanterns in the garden near the casino began to dim and go out. It creates an unpleasant atmosphere and can be dangerous for our residents. My husband was predictably useless in this situation, so I decided to take the initiative.

I ask you to help us fix these lanterns, . They don't just illuminate our garden, but also symbolize the light and hope we want to bring to our city. Your help will be invaluable to us.

May the light of the lanterns illuminate your path and remind us of your gallantry. Good luck to you, dear heroes, and may your work be blessed!
Lanterns are lit? Excellent! Our guests will be safe now!
Give Herman de Venar's letter to Lisa.

"You will receive a fatal blow from the one who, while being madly in love, will come to ask you about the three cards."

Ah, what does it matter! Even if I had it! Everything is lost now... I'm alone.

I'm not afraid of the storm! Passions have awakened in me with such deadly force that thunder is nothing in comparison! As long as I live, I will not give her up!

Thunder, lightning, and wind! I solemnly swear to you that she will be mine. She will be mine, mine, mine, or I will die!

Beauty! Goddess! Angel! I wrote everything in this letter... , go to her and beg her for an answer! Just make sure no one sees you! I have many enemies... Once you deliver the letter, return to my house - I'll be waiting! Quickly, or my heart will break!
Hurry, I beg you! Or I will die...

Ah, if only I could see her, it would help me drop this idea... Three cards...! Three cards and I'll be rich...! And we can run away together... Damn it...! This is going to drive me insane! If only I could learn the old woman's secret!
Escort Herman de Venar to Lisa Golitsyna while avoiding trouble or protecting him from it.

"Madly in love!" Well? It's about me, isn't it? I'm madly in love... yes! Well? Am I afraid?

so can we! It's decided, I'll learn the secret from the old woman! But what if there is no secret? And it's just delirium of my sick soul?

I need to talk to Lisa... Maybe she can learn the secret?! , let's go to her! I have to learn this secret!
Let's hurry! We need to find Lisa and learn the secret!
I have many enemies and even more debts... Everyone wants me dead! But Lisa... I knew she would love me!
Talk to Lisa Golitsyna and return to Herman de Venar
, here it is, the Golitsyn mansion... The old woman lives here with Lisa... It looks like everyone is asleep and Lisa is waiting for me! Let's find her!
We must go back... I need to think...
Three cards? Will she tell me the secret? I must know it! Everything can still be changed!
But who are you? What do you want?

h: A friend sent me... He asked me to deliver this letter...

t: Oh god, oh god! Is she... dead?
I knew the price of Elleken's secret would be my life... I was not destined to be resurrected again, so tomorrow I will leave this world for good...
h: Herman didn't kill you, he's not guilty!

t:
So that's why he's here! Not for me! He wanted to know the three cards! It wasn't me he wanted, it was the cards...

Oh my God, oh my God! I loved him...! Monster! Murderer! Fiend!
Complete all quests of Anna Golitsyna

Before I tell you the secret, you need to fulfill my tasks, ... Lisa is my heir and I will leave everything to her.

You need to find something in the Tulensky Swamps.
The secret of the three cards is this. Remember! Three! Seven! Ace! Three, seven, ace! Farewell...
Use the metal detector to find Lisa's dowry.

I ordered my servants to put my gold in a chest and bury it in the swamp. Alas, it won't be easy to find it now: the person who buried it there has long since disappeared.

But it is possible to find the chest using a metal detector - all you need to do is explore the swamp. Of course, it could be a false positive and you will find one of the local ghosts instead. Be careful, !
Excellent! This gold will make Lisa one of the richest brides...
Find the treasure in the swamps using the metal detector.

Today I'm asking you, , to help us find the treasure hidden in the swamp near the city. It may be a dangerous undertaking, but I believe in your courage. The treasures will help improve the lives of our citizens and make our city even better.

Your help will be invaluable to us, and I promise that your work will not go unnoticed. Let us make our city a prosperous place for all its residents. May the treasures we find bring us happiness and prosperity.
Have you found the treasure? Wonderful! Now we have enough funds to develop the city!
Eliminate 4 Ghostly Slugs, 4 Ghostly Centipedes, and 8 Ghostly Gnats.

Yes, the swamps are not empty – a huge number of the most vile creatures have gathered there... It's disgusting...

It's one of the reasons why I'm not coming with you – I hate seeing them.

So I ask you to eliminate them if you can, . The last thing I need is for them to get into the city. My grandson and granddaughter live there!
There is always some kind of infection in the swamps...
Eliminate 8 Ghostly Slugs, 8 Centipedes, and 8 Gnats.

My wife has convinced me that ghostly gnats, slugs and centipedes need to be dealt with. These creatures pose a threat to public health and well-being. We cannot allow them to continue to spread terror among the population.

Help us rid our region of gnats, slugs and centipedes.

I ask you, , to accept the challenge and help us get rid of these terrible creatures. I understand that this is a difficult task, but I believe in your abilities. Help us restore peace and prosperity in our region. Thank you for your understanding and assistance.
The swamp ghosts are gone? This is great news for the whole city!

My death caused confusion in my household - my faithful servants left the house trying to find me... Their names are Lyuba, Zinaida, Michelle, and Slap... They thought I'd be in this swamp, but they were wrong. That's where they stayed. They are alive for the time being, but the swamp will claim them soon. Find them before that happens and bring them back here, .
I hope they will serve Lisa as faithfully as they have served me...
It looks like the elf is dead... The Countess's ghost will be very unhappy about this. We need to think of something, find some kind of replacement...
Go to the casino with Herman and play using the secret of three cards

, let's go! Go where? Where...? To the gambling house! There are piles of gold there, and they belong to me. Me alone! I know the three cards! She told the secret to her murderer! It was destined by fate, I had to commit a villainy, but that was the price!
Quickly! Quickly! I can't wait anymore!

He seems to have gone mad... He risked everything and lost... How many are like that, overcome with excitement, ready to gamble everything they have for the illusory chance of winning...

Luck is treacherous: today you are on top, and tomorrow... who knows what tomorrow will bring?
Visit the city archives and find documents on the lineage.

Good to see you again...

Why are you here? Documents?

What's going on there,

in the city's archives?

The creatures of Darkness have infiltrated...

I've had a chance to hear

Of the new trouble of all sorts...

Kidnappings, evil beasts...

That threaten the city folk...
Yes, this is really them, the spoilers...
Greetings to you, my dear friend!
Find Katerina Kabanova in the Kelinovka village, to the southwest of Sardrok.

Just recently, out south was sent,

To Sardrok Palace yonder,

A part of city's archives.

They've fallen in these evil hands

That claim the palace now.

I know just who can give you help:

You go to Katerina, who is now

The thunder maiden of the place.

With her, the path you seek is found.

Alexander is right – the south is restless. After the events on Jigran in the eighth century, Sardrok was destroyed, and fell into complete desolation with time. The elves of House de Delice who arrived here around ten years ago also reconstructed it. They wanted to create a summer palace there – for those who would want to take a break from Dar Ulgorn.

So it was, and even during Hirkalla's rule the place was relatively calm – more so since the palace was surrounded by the army of the undead that was unreservedly obeying the dark goddess' generals.
Put up magical protection along the riverbank with Katerina's help.
Until the protection is put up, I can't leave Kelinovka!
Well, so we have put up protection for Kelinovka – I hope it is able to stop the wandering undead. And now, we will learn what is happening out south...
Wipe the area clean of undead and help the weakened Junes.

For far too long my people have been enslaved in the shadow of Sardrok! This is not going to happen again! The ghosts of Junes who died under the yoke of Firez are all around, but they may awaken. The undead must be destroyed, their power collected, so that my people may rise again. We are still capable of much, even though we are dead now. May the Old Man tremble, for the Junes have returned!

The undead will bar our way no more. We will camp it up here and hold the ground. Let them even try poking out of the gates – we will drop the hammer on their undead skulls at once. If you need something, ask my comrades.
Enter Sardrok and eliminate the possessed carriage
It will not be easy to vanquish the mad vehicle possessed by the spirit of carnage!
We've done it! Never again will the carriage kidnap or crush anyone!
Here, we encounter the Old Man – he's carrying out the will of Tep.
Have you managed to kill the Old Man?
The Old Man has been killed, hooray!
There you are! Indeed, this is a fascinating story...

Well, does that mean the deceiver has seen the light?

I don't blame her - she's young and naive.

I was foolish, got into an argument with a wrong person...

Molchalin is a scoundrel. But he got what he deserved.
Eliminate 50 hostile or neutral creatures on Jigran and accumulate 30 measures of Spark energy, then report to Sarang Kido.

, do you feel like you haven't achieved everything you set out to on Jigran? Not ready for further exploits? I know how to help you. There are many enemies on Jigran. You will find them everywhere. Fight them, and you will quickly achieve perfection. It's also a way to accumulate Spark energy!
The more enemies you defeat, the stronger you become! Thank you for the Spark energy, I'll find a use for it.

I would like to ask something of you. I know that Catherina wisely rules Umoir for the good of this land, and I'm not going to interfere with that. However, there's something we didn't tell her, there was no time to share old secrets.

Now is the time to tell her everything she needs to know. Umoir is an ancient land and it keeps many secrets, and the secret of the Burial Mound and the demon buried in it is only one of many.

Give this message to Catherina, she will understand everything.
Take my letter to Catherina as soon as possible...

You! Well, I'm glad to see you, in spite of everything...

I know what is happening on Jigran - the entire Conclave is carefully watching the actions of the darkest empress. Cosmos and the Sculptor decided to complain about you here - but forget about it, they are not important right now. I think you should unquestioningly obey Hirkalla for now - after all, her interests currently coincide with the interests of Sarnaut. Do it even if her actions seem appalling to you, because you can't cook an omelet without breaking eggs.

Thank you for Skrakan's message - the sly old fox managed to hide something from me here on Umoir. I'll figure it out.
Get to Kelinovka Settlement on a carriage.

, I believe we should visit the village that lies to the south of here. The village between the rivers bears the name of Cyrus's beloved, the Xadaganian woman Keli he met on Suslanger... But that is the story of the past...

And we are interested in the present...

Who are you?! What do you want? Strangers are not welcome here. Especially idle ones... Since you're here, we might as well put you to work. Otherwise... There are too many of you idlers around... Thinking you're too good for dirty work!

Even if you're famous heroes or saviors of Sarnaut, roll up your sleeves first, and then you can start asking questions!
Talk to Katerina in the backyard.

What do you need? Our Katerina? Really?!

Why would you need that good-for-nothing laggard? She's useless! She can't manage the household, she forgets everything and mixes things up... No, I don't believe you, , you need someone else, not this bungler! Now our neighbor, Alenka - she's an alright girl, but Katerina... Pshaw!

Okay, if you need to talk, talk - maybe she'll calm down. There she is crying behind the house...
You should work around the house instead of crying all day long.

Well, did you learn anything?

You won't learn anything from this blockhead... All she knows is how to cry and whine... Useless! But you can try and wait until she calms down!

Ohh... Aaah... *sob* I can't... I can't stand her...

She keeps berating me... *sob* my mother-in-law...

Ohh... *sob* they married me off to a man I didn't love! *sob* This is no living with her! I'm a disgrace to the family now... *sob* I wish I'd died...
Find Katerina, talk to her, and then go to the healer.

Just look at her! She has no shame! Where did she go? Huh? Housework won't do itself. The dough is not mixed, the floors are not swept! What kind of wife is she?

Where has she been? Must have run off to her lover! No shame whatsoever! Come on, . Go find her and bring her back! Or else I'll go myself!

What? Is Katerina still suffering? Yes... What should we do about her? She's so strange. She might do something...

I feel sorry for her. Martha is eating her alive, and she walks around like a shadow, unresponsive. Just cries all the time.
Oh, Oak, what is this? Why...

It was under this oak tree that it all happened. I cried so much and hurt myself... I can't escape this sin. I can't escape it. It's not good, it's a terrible sin that I love another. Where can I go? Who can help me? My God, I am perishing! I don't need anything, and the light of God no longer matters to me! And death would not come. You call for it, but it does not come. It would be better if I was struck by lightning and killed on the spot.
Search 3 stashes in the forest and find great-grandfather's "treasure".

I'm actually a local! Or rather, my great-grandfather was from these parts... Or great-great-grandfather? It's hard to say...

Anyway, he served in the army of Baron Virril himself. Yes, the same one who held the fortress of Dar Leanos to the north of here... But as soon as the necromancer Firez was defeated, the baron had to leave through a portal to Ingos along with all the residents... Everything here was poisoned.

But that's fine. Sooner or later we will turn Jigran into a flourishing land! And my family legend says that my great-grandfather buried his most precious treasure in this forest... , maybe you can look for it while I'll try to think of a way to help Katerina?
So that's what great-grandfather hid in the forest! And there was so much talk! Family legend! Ugh...

We can't tell which creature will come to life, and which will wander around as a disembodied thing... However, sometimes the living cause as much harm as the dead...

Everyone here hopes to come back to life eventually, so they will need cattle, birds, dogs of all sorts, so there is food and someone to guard the house...

There are too many lynxes in the forest... There is no prey for them, and so they attack everything they can find... , we need to reduce their numbers before it gets worse...
We'll sew fur coats for the villagers!
That's better. Even though I'm a hunter, I'm afraid to go into the forest myself...

My wife convinced me that lynxes pose a serious problem: they terrorize the villagers. Residents are afraid to leave their homes, and livestock becomes easy prey for these dangerous animals.

Help us protect our residents from lynxes and restore peace.

I understand that this is a difficult task, but I believe in your abilities. Help us restore peace and prosperity in our region. Thank you for your understanding and assistance.
There are more lynxes every day... And their hunger is growing.
Use a tame owl to catch 10 hares and give them to the hunter.

Oh, I always wanted a dog, but I never got around to it... But I tamed two owls.

Their names are Brownie and Snowflake. I think it's clear which is which. I trained them to hunt hares... No one else has such excellent hunters... Maybe you want to try, ? Get us some hare meat for lunch... and it'll be practice for the owls.
Well, how is my little owl?
Catch 10 hares using a tame owl.

Today I ask you, , to help us catch the hares with the help of special hunting owls. These hares have caused discontent among the population of the neighboring village, because they are destroying the crops and causing damage to our fields. As usual, my husband was unable to handle this problem, but I know that you can help us with this difficult situation.

I believe your courage and bravery will help you successfully complete this mission. Catching the hares will help us improve the situation in our city and protect our fields from further destruction, which will also solve the problem of food scarcity. Your help will be invaluable to us, and I promise that your work will not go unnoticed.

Let the caught hares become a symbol of our victory and bring us luck and prosperity.
Did you catch any hares? Well, at least we have some food now.
Tell Katerina what the healer said.

Oh, , I don't know how to help Katerina... If she feels guilty, then she can only pray and fast. You must forgive yourself first.

Tell her that I wish her all the best. If her mother-in-law really gets on her nerves, let her come here. I have tea and biscuits.

Oh no, this is bad...

I wanted to ask Dikin to let me go live with his nephew... But he just scolded me and shooed me away... I'm lost...
Why don't people fly! Why don't people fly like birds? Sometimes I think I'm a bird. When you stand on a mountain, you just want to fly. I would run up, raise my arms and fly.

Ugh, you're so stupid...

What are you hanging around here for, ? Huh?! Don't you have anything to do?

Then help me out! I have business in town, but my horse hasn't been delivered yet. The lord promised me a horse, but there's none... Go and see what's going on there... He should be somewhere near the swamps...

Hello!

You need a horse, you say? Hmm... Well, I did promise him one. However, we have our own problems here... Escaped prisoners are hiding in the swamps, and this dog is...

The horses have gone mad! And the wolves...
Tell Dikin that the promised horse will arrive soon.
Well, , since I promised, here's the horse for the merchant. Let him go to the city. Maybe he'll bring back some goods!

So what about my horse? Well, he should hurry up!

Katerina? Your Katerina is a stupid girl! Nothing but tears. I don't know where she is, she ran off. Good riddance. I have to go.

Look at the storm outside!
Eliminate 12 Ghostly Slugs in the gardens.

Hey, ! Ready to work?! We don't tolerate people who hang around doing nothing! We'll throw them in a pit and call it a day.
And can you really leave our village without help?!
We want to have gardens and orchards here again... We barely sowed anything when the damned slugs showed up. Hungry despite being ghosts. They'll devour everything! The people saw them and gave up - because what's the point?!

We need to get rid of the slugs!
This nasty stuff is still crawling around the gardens!
Phew, finally! Now these idlers have something to do.
Eliminate 12 Ghostly Slugs in the village.

My wife is a strong-willed, liberal woman. Her ability to see the world and problems from a different perspective made me reconsider my beliefs. She convinced me that the ghostly slugs that terrorize the village near our city need to be dealt with. These creatures pose a danger to the residents - now they are afraid to leave their homes.

, accept this challenge and help us destroy these creatures that brought fear and chaos to the village. Help us restore peace in our city. May your courage lead us to victory over this threat.
Slugs are gone? So we can expect to have food soon!
Defeat the Scarecrow in the field.

Hey, you! Yes, you, ! Come here! And don't give me that look - what's that for? Can't you see who's in front of you? Huh?! Huh?! I see that you see.

Listen, we used to have a scarecrow here to chase away the crows. But then that damned thunderstorm happened, a lightning struck here, and the scarecrow started wandering around. That's just wrong! Scarecrows shouldn't walk around! What are you laughing at? Huh?

Are you laughing at me? I'll punch you in the teeth!

Such disrespect... Anyway, go... deal with this! Put it back where it was!

There you go! Keep that up!

Why are you standing around? Get out of here!
Straighten 15 leaning fences in the village.

Hey, boygirl, look at this - maybe you can help us out?

At night, ghosts of all kinds of animals wander around here... moaning, whispering... breaking down fences... who knows what they want... It's not like we can reason with them.

We are simple folk - we want to settle down here and restore the village... When we rise again, we'll have our own gardens. But if they destroy them, we'll have nothing... Maybe you can fix the fences?
You should be more careful with it! It will fall apart!

Oh, if I were alive, I would've had a heart attack seeing you kick that fence! I thought they were old and ready to crumble to dust. But it turned out nice.

These things might be old, but if you take care of them, they will last.
Straighten 15 leaning fences in the village.

Today I ask you, , to help us repair the fences in the village near the city. This village has served our city for many years, providing it with food and helping us in various ways. However, the fences around the village need repairing to ensure the safety of the locals.

As usual, my husband was unable to handle this problem, but I know that you can help us with this difficult situation. Let the repaired fences become a symbol of our care for the neighboring villages!
Did you fix the fence? The villagers will be extremely grateful for this!

So there are other lands beyond our borders! How amazing! And we sit here knowing nothing. It's good that there are kind people: every now and then you hear what's going on in the world, otherwise we would die like fools.
Check the marked spots in the village with Ivan Kuligin and place 5 lightning rods.

Oh, these folks... They're ready to hound their own people to death, and there's no rest for the poor things even in the next world! They're all angry...

And they're afraid of thunderstorms... But what's there to be afraid of? It's a natural phenomenon... We know how to deal with them!

I'm Ivan Kuligin, an inventor... I want to invent a perpetual motion machine. One that can turn a mill without any wind... It would be quite useful.

But first, let's deal with the thunderstorm... We need to install special things — lightning rods. It will attract the lightning, and the current will go into the ground. So no more fear! Well, , will you help me place them? I'll show you where!

Well, what did I say? There's a resourceful mind for every misfortune... And you, sirmadam, are you staying in our village for long? Perhaps you can help us with something else... There's a lot to do... Master doesn't have time for us, he's too afraid of the dog that lives in the swamp.
Defeat the nobleman's "ancestral curse" dwelling in the swamps.

, have you heard the bloodcurdling howl? Everyone can hear it! How ironic! Yes, this dog is really bothering me… Do you want to know what's going on?

My sad story is this: once upon a time, my ancestor, who lived on Jigran before Firez and the Xadaganians appeared, decided to kidnap a girl, the daughter of a local farmer… She escaped from him that same night! My ancestor gave chase, and it led him to these swamps…

There he met a monstrous glowing dog and was fatally wounded by it. When the servants arrived, he told them what happened, then died. Since then, this terrible creature has been haunting his descendants on Jigran… And then I decided to come back here… and now this terrible howling wakes me up every night...

A dog, you say? A collar with a name on it? Chestnut, then... You're right about that... Is there really no curse?

That dog is so far from the circus, on the other end of town! Tell George to keep a closer eye on his pets. Or else I'll file a complaint with Empress Hirkalla, and they'll kick him off our allod in a jiffy!

Oh...

Well, at least I can get some sleep now.
A few more weeks of oatmeal for breakfast and I swear I'll howl like that dog!
Drive 6 stray horses back to the herd.

I'm not the only one hearing that howl... Everyone can hear it. Even my butler, who feeds me oatmeal...

And the horses... they are timid creatures... As soon as that monster howls, they scatter in all directions...

I could wait until they return, but since you need a horse for your trip... Besides, there's always a chance that wolves will attack them! Please, , take this horn. Blow it - the horses will hear it... and come running back.
The horses are safe, it seems... That's great! Good horses are expensive these days! The old nobility doesn't like these fast-moving Manabikes, they prefer horses.
Drive 6 stray horses back to the herd.

I, Andrey Lemkov, the governor of this land, ask you for help in a very serious matter. I recently received information that a gentleman living in the village outside the city has encountered a problem.

This gentleman, a man of the old school, lives by the old rules and values. He has a herd of horses which are like family to him. But recently they were attacked by wolves, so they ran away. The gentleman is unable to find his pets on his own.

My wife, Julia Lemkova, is a strong-willed woman. She reminded me that strength lies in unity and cooperation. She convinced me to turn to you, , and ask you to help the gentleman get his horses back. For this we will need a special horn that will lure the horses and help gather them together.

Help the man get his horses back. Give us the opportunity to show compassion and kindness.
The horses are back? The master can live in peace, his pets are now safe.
Kill 9 swamp wolves around the pasture.

, it'd be nice if you could deal with the wolves... The animals are slowly coming back to life, but the corrupted creatures are stronger.

So the wolves aren't going back to the swamps while that horror is there. Now they are attacking my horses. Soon they'll start hunting the villagers.
I'm sure the wolves will rise again eventually, too! But for now at least it will be more peaceful... The thunderstorm is bad enough, we don't need wild animals to make things worse!
Kill 6 Swamp Wolves and defeat the Swamp Horror.

Today I ask you, , to help us with a very serious matter. A huge ghost dog lives in the swamps near our town, scaring residents and livestock. A pack of swamp wolves has joined it, thus making the threat worse.

As usual, my husband is unable or unwilling to deal with this problem. So I'm asking you to eliminate this threat and ensure the safety of our residents.

Let the elimination of the ghost dog and the swamp wolves become a symbol of our strength and determination. Good luck to you, dear heroes!
The evil dog and its pack are gone? Great, the lord will sleep peacefully!
Ask the woodcutter, healer, and undertaker about Katerina.

The storm is getting stronger, and Katerina is missing! If this disaster is really because of her, then who knows what will happen if we don't find her. Maybe this storm will kill us all and tear the village to pieces!

The whole village is looking for her! Please help, !

Oh, I hope nothing happens!
Don't touch me! I'll jump! I swear I'll jump!
During the fight with Katerina, make her angry and get her to destroy the places she hates.

! I can't do this anymore! This life is not worth it!

I hate everything here! If I had the will and the strength, I would smash this oak tree to pieces, burn Dikin to ashes, and raze Kabanova's damned house to the ground!

But I don't have that kind of power, so there's only one way out for me - into the water!

Ohh, I can't do this anymore!

Oh... Oh, I feel sick!

Oh... what happened to me? What a wonderful dream! Oh, my soul feels so light!

...Oh, did I really do all this? Incredible...

And look, the storm is over!

!!! You idiotidiot! What have you  donedone?! I'll destroy you!

I thought a herohero had arrived whowho would help us all, and what do you do? You and that witch destroyed our home! I wish we had never let Katerina into our family!

Well, I hope you're happy now! But I won't let this go easily - I'll make sure you pay for everything you've destroyed!
Her fate could have been completely different. Darker.
Anyway, we have a few more fates to sort out. I feel like we're getting close.
Why are you standing here? What are you looking at? You don't respect your elders! You should listen to your elders!
Talk to Hirkalla near her palace.

What have you been up to, ? Mutiny? Riot?

My sister thinks she can stop me? Using my own methods? With the help of these pathetic fanatics? We'll see...

But you... Look around you! I conquered death - isn't that wonderful? Yes, things are not perfect, there are problems, but we have just begun. We will create a world with our own rules where everyone will be happy eventually.

Do you have any objections?
It's beautiful here, isn't it? Cool, gloomy, and foggy. And the dead walk among the living. Just the way I like it!
The Paladins' power is their belief in their own righteousness. But they are just people - and all people have desires, fears, and secrets. Nobody is perfect.

It's good to see a familiar face in the land of shadows, !

The vampires' lot is a difficult one. As agreed, we fought in Nihaz's Citadel, protecting the rest of the inhabitants of Sarnaut. In exchange, we were promised a cure which would lift our curse and a new land that we would call home - Jigran.

But things turned out differently - we are back in the service, but this time of the Goddess of Darkness. And again we are part of the army, but now the enemy is different - it's the Light.

Alas, we have no other choice - Hiero's Paladins want to destroy all vampires, and Hirkalla can resurrect them. Our warriors are fighting bravely there, near the bridges... Please, collect the Sparks of the dead and revive them with the help of the artifact that I'll give you.
Will my vampires ever be free? I ask that myself every day.
Thank you! Our service allows us to resurrect out of turn - so vampire guards will soon rejoin the fight against the Light.

Our loyal guardsmen continue to sacrifice their lives - because the empress has many enemies: Paladins, distorted creatures, and now nihilists...

Vampires die particularly quickly, and they are our backbone. Annette once again asks you to revive them as soon as possible. I'll give you the device, and you'll go to the battlefield and revive the poor creatures, .

Then report to Gort, he commands the forces here.
Have you brought back the bloodsuckers? Excellent, we'll send them back to the frontline. That's their vampire lot - being first to the fray.
Eliminate 10 Paladins who infiltrated Hirkalla's territory, then report to Danas.

, my friend! It's good to see you!

As you already know, when Hirkalla came to our world, she took control of all undead armies gathered by Dakkar and his apprentices.

Now these immortal warriors are stationed in Dar Leanos and Sardrok, to the north and south of here. As for us, the heroes of old - we serve the Goddess of Darkness as generals. We have no choice - the bonds of dark magic chaining our will are stronger than meteorite ore.

On the other hand, I don't sympathize with these warriors, the Paladins. They are quick to judge and execute. So this is my order: defend the bridges and knock the enemies out of their foothold on this bank.

Mission accomplished. Thank you for your service.

All we want now is peace. We've stood guard too long...

Our main enemy is Hiero's cursed Paladins. It's not enough that they are sitting in the Cathedral, out of our reach - they are also trying to establish footholds in the city.

They are trying to break through the bridge to the Palace!

We can't let this happen, so here is my order; eliminate a dozen Paladins that break through.
Are you done? Phew, excellent! If they had gotten here, I would've been done for!
Defeat, then mount the three feral guards and bring them back.

The vampire guard and revived people cannot hold the bridge, !

Fortunately, the empress does not rely only on them. With her magic, she awakened the ancient Hickut guards - the Sphinxes. These creatures made of granite and bronze are virtually invulnerable. However, controlling them requires considerable effort.

After falling into a battle rage, the Sphinxes got out of control and started attacking everyone.

You need to pacify the Hickut guards by mounting them and returning them to their pedestals.
The undead are easier to manage than these cats.
These hideous creatures can cause a lot of trouble. But under our empress's control they are a formidable force for our enemies.
Defeat, then mount the three feral guards and bring them back.

One of our main units are the stone Hickut guards, awakened by the magic of the empress, . They guard the Palace, and not only that.

There is one problem - they are too wayward and easily get out of control. But there is a way to fix this - give them a thrashing, then mount them and take them back to the pedestal. They will come to their senses.

Once you are done, report to the Wanderer - he's been assigned to keep an eye on them.
The stone guards of Hickut have been sleeping for centuries, and now they are awake. They need to be tamed again, and this will take some time.
Go to the Cathedral and get into the minds of Marianne, Negus Tot, and Hiero. Shake their faith in the power of the Light. Report to the Wanderer when you are done.

Have you ever heard of the Trojan horse, ? On a distant world, besiegers were able to infiltrate an enemy city by convincing the defenders to accept a false gift. Today you are going to be that gift.

I learned to sow doubts, temptations and discord when I served Nihaz. One spark is often enough to ignite a flame. This is what I did to Kyros, fueling his despair, resentment and anger.

The Paladins think their Shield of Faith reliably protects them from Darkness. We'll do this - you will go to the temple and poison their thoughts with the help of a special artifact that I will give you.
Everyone has a weak point. Everyone.

Now the leaders of the Paladins are in the grip of temptation, fear, and rage, and their shield is weakening. Once its integrity is compromised, our lady will order a full frontal attack on the Cathedral.
Ask the ghosts about the circumstances of their second death, then report to Reniesta.

So, are you running errands for the Empress now, ? Alright.

We have another problem here besides the fact that we can't resurrect everyone at once - those who were previously resurrected started dying again. Or disappearing.

We'll never be done at this rate, and the people are getting angry.

Anyway, find the freshly dead ones and ask why they died again and ruined my reports, the bastards?
We can't keep resurrecting them! There's already a line that's a hundred years long!
No, I won't give them to you! I won't! They are mine! I earned them! I won!
Ah, my friend! Misfortune is a contagious disease. The unfortunate and poor need to stay away from each other so as not to get any worse.
There is no need to get involved in other people's troubles. If you take it all to heart, it's no wonder you are the most unhappy person out there.
h: You've just been resurrected, why are you a ghost again?

t: I don't want to study, I want to get married. Mother!
Eliminate 20 Spark Eaters and replenish 5 lanterns with Spark energy. Report to Gorislav Averchenko

Hey, come here, ! The Empress said we can put you to work...

The thing is, we are protecting the ghosts that we released, but they get attacked often - by distorted creatures and other ghosts. And now a new misfortune - we are plagued by Spark Eaters, Tep's creations.

They consume Spark energy! The residents are now in dire straits. They have barely enough energy to continue existing. There is only one salvation from these creatures - the Soul Lanterns which weaken these parasites, so killing them becomes a piece of cake.

You need to refill the lanterns and disperse the Spark Eaters.
Spark Eaters become vulnerable near Soul Lanterns.
That's great. Now the resurrected will have fewer problems and a lot more faith in the good intentions of our mistress.
Eliminate 20 Spark Eaters and replenish 5 lanterns with Spark energy.

So many parasites have descended on Jigran, !

There are Spark Eaters now, imagine that... Tep's creations, curse them... We both have handled them before, so you know what to do. Beat the nasties, lure them to the lantern, and destroy them there. And the lanterns need to be refilled...

Afterwards, inform the Wanderer - he's still trying to come up with a solution to this problem...
Spark Eaters are magical creatures. Once Tep was able to tame them and compel them to harvest Sparks for him...
Kill 6 Drowner Ghouls at the bottom of the canal and report back to Foma Opiskin.

Hey, hey! Stop! !

I have a very important meeting here. I will become the richest man on Jigran!

I'll tell you everything, but only in exchange for one favor: there's something at the bottom of the river canal! Something nasty! Deal with it!

Whaaat? What are you standing around for?! Don't think, just dive!
They don't deserve this... They don't deserve this!
[You are late - Foma Opiskin is dead - his body is completely drained of blood. But there is an extremely curious piece of paper in his pocket...]
Show the note to Annette de Tristesse.

The promissory note found on the dead body contains the promise of a certain Huntsman to issue a hundred Sparks to whoever presents it.

We should show this note to Annette de Tristesse, she might know something about her wards' dealings.
It is not easy to control vampires in the current situation... My people expect a lot from me...

This is outrageous, ! If we didn't know each other, I'd think you want to destroy our reputation which took a great effort to restore.

But I see no point in denying it - what you are saying can only be the work of my people.

Give me this... piece of paper.
Find the Huntsman, disguise yourself and find out what is going on.

Here's what we'll do, .

I will give you a little thing that will deceive the eyes and scent of any ordinary vampire. And you will find this Huntsman and learn everything you can from him.

When the opportunity arises, I want you to thoroughly admonish on my behalf those who allow themselves to discredit the name of my House.
How can I be of help?
You are lucky: the scale of the hunt is truly unprecedented now. There are a lot of people in my lands wishing to participate - both among the "hares" and our brethren. Welcome!

The laws of nature are simple and unpretentious - hares eat grass, wolves eat hares.

Who are you in this cycle?
You don't look like a "hare", sirmadam, the shade of your skin indicates the opposite.

In that case, let me warmly welcome you to my hunting grounds.

But a wolf, as you know, hunts in a pack. Your face is unfamiliar to me, which means you are not part of the pack.

Hahaha! Very funny!

But you are right, on Jigran any living soul can become food for another... less living one.

"Hares" are resurrected residents who have negligible means of subsistence. They are in desperate need of juicy fresh grass. Sparks, that is.

And then it's us – the "wolves". We have what the "hares" need - you yourself have made a generous contribution. This amount became part of the main prize which will go to the fastest bunny.

I just help the "hares" and "wolves" give each other what they need.
h: What's that about wolves and hares?

t:
Listen to the rules of the hunt and join it, but make your own rules: kill the vampire "wolves", harvest their Sparks, tear the masks off the "hares", then deal with the Huntsman himself.

Report to Annette de Tristes after the "hunt".

You see, you are a little late - the hunt is already in full swing, . But don't worry, you will have time to enjoy it!

I will quickly bring you up to date.

As I already said: hares eat grass, wolves eat hares...
How can I be of help?

I had no doubt that I could rely on you. I will deal with these disobedient Sparks myself.

Go reassure Reniesta that no one will eat her precious wards anymore.
Kill 12 vampire "wolves", harvest their Sparks, tear the masks off the "hares", then deal with the Huntsman himself.

It looks like there's no stopping some of Annette's pets, ... Especially this Astolf, an ancient ghoul who incites other vampires to commit all sorts of atrocities.

Well, the empress was clear - those who misbehave will be disciplined.

Stop these strange games, collect Vampire Sparks, and give the Huntsman a good thrashing!

Then tell Annette about it.
Oh, this Astolf - he's nothing but trouble... Where did he come from? One of Canaan's fosterlings probably...

These wayward vampires not just kill townspeople - they also engage in other indecent activities, . They started smuggling Psi-Salt from the Dead Sea...

We don't need that garbage here, so I wanted you to search all their stashes in the park, take psi-salt and bring it to Annette.
It's a disgrace... How could they...? I'll talk to my vampires and give them a severe reprimand.
Take a carriage to Famusov with Alyosha

Madman...

Ignorant people called Tep a madman... But was he really that mad, ? Perhaps he saw something others could not see?

Perhaps this guest who caused a scandal is not mad either... If he acted strangely, could this mean his new destiny did not fit him either?

I suggest starting with him, since it's not far away. Famusov Estate where the rich and noble from all over Dar Ulgorn gather... Let's go there?

Where did you come from?

The empress's palace? Very interesting...

Welcome! However, I have nothing to offer my guests...
Carry out the orders of Hirkalla's generals and ask them about the cases of stolen destinies, then share the news with Alyosha.

As I said, , Hirkalla's generals control the news all over the city. We need to ask them about all the "unusual" cases when people start behaving strangely.

We'll have evidence that their destiny was stolen from them.
Do people's destinies change, or is it the destinies themselves that change one performer to another if the first one turns out to be unsuitable?

Excellent! Seven people: a madman, a loafer, an egoist, a hysterical woman, a gambler, a cynic, and a maniac... These are clearly "odd people out", and perhaps their destinies were stolen. After visiting them, we will understand what happened to them and how...
Find Sofia Famusova's diary and the pages from it.

Disregard my father...

He always grumbles, scolds and makes one feel unhappy.

Loses temper for no reason...

I have a request for you. Gorgoyles came from the sky,

And took my diary.

They tore it apart, dropping pieces all over the neighborhood.

I would like to get it back - I'll be eternally grateful to you!

Chatsky, you like to dress everyone as jesters,

Would you like to try it on yourself?

She unknowingly drove me mad.

What do I care about them all? About the universe?

Perhaps it was frivolous of me,

Chatsky and I grew up together...

We spent all time together

As friends in childhood days.

Molchalin is a terrible person!

I'm so ashamed.

Who could think he was so cunning!
Kill the spiders in Famusov's garden.

Forgive me! I welcome guests...

But there is trouble in my house...

An infestation of dreadful creatures!

I ask you to help - to chase away the spiders.

Those vile furry legs.

The numerous eyes. And mandibles.

What do I do when they say

That Famusov Estate is in disarray.

Thank you, things are quiet now.

I can invite guests and give ball...
Find Famusov's servants and bring them to him.

Another problem: when this scandal happened,

All servants scattered.

Now I can't find them anywhere!

Find my lazy servants - they might be in trouble.

If they are, save them. I have no desire to look for new ones.
